sql: select 'ord' k, created_at::text t, left(client_order_id,12)||' '||action||' '||side||' '||limit_price||'x'||quantity||' '||status||' '||coalesce(cancel_reason,'') v from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and market_ticker='KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT25-PEAC' union all select 'pos', captured_at::text, quantity::text||' fp '||quantity_fp::text from (select * from positions where market_ticker='KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT25-PEAC' order by captured_at desc limit 1) p union all select 'snap', at::text, best_yes_bid||'/'||best_no_bid from (select * from incentive_market_snapshots where market_ticker='KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT25-PEAC' and at > now()-interval '3 hours' order by at desc limit 4) s union all select 'fills', min(filled_at)::text, count(*)||' rows qty '||sum(quantity) from fills where market_ticker='KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT25-PEAC' order by 1,2
